description_en: This API is used to obtain the regional distribution data of quality statistics
description_zh: 本接口用于获取质量统计的地域分布数据
name: DescribeQualityAreaDistributionStatData

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: End Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Parent area name. For example, the parent of Hangzhou City is Zhejiang Province, and the parameter value should be China_Zhejiang Province. If the parameter is empty, statistics are returned at the world level (country dimension), such as China or the United Kingdom.
parameters.help_zh: 父级地区名称，例如：杭州市的父级为浙江省，参数设为中国_浙江省。参数为空表示世界范围（国家维度）的统计，例如：中国、英国
parameters.name: parent_area

v1_parameters.help_en: End Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
v1_parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
v1_parameters.name: EndDate

v1_parameters.help_en: Parent area name. For example, the parent of Hangzhou City is Zhejiang Province, and the parameter value should be China_Zhejiang Province. If the parameter is empty, statistics are returned at the world level (country dimension), such as China or the United Kingdom
v1_parameters.help_zh: 父级地区名称，例如：杭州市的父级为浙江省，参数设为中国_浙江省。参数为空表示世界范围（国家维度）的统计，例如：中国、英国
v1_parameters.name: ParentArea

v1_parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
v1_parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
v1_parameters.name: StartDate
